aboutSections.title: The project
paragraphs: The Bibliography of Belgian History (Bibliographie de l’Histoire de Belgique, BHB; Bibliografie van de Geschiedenis van België, BGB) records each year the publications on the history of Belgium and of the territories that preceded it: books, articles, chapters, editions of sources and exhibition catalogues. It is compiled under the Royal Commission of History.
This site searches the whole bibliography at once, in French, Dutch and English. The wording of an entry stays the wording of the printed volume.

aboutSections.title: Where the data comes from
paragraphs: The volumes for 1952–2017 were published each year in the Revue belge de philologie et d’histoire / Belgisch Tijdschrift voor Filologie en Geschiedenis. This site includes those printed volumes: the years 1952–2007 as transcribed into XML in 2023, and 1964, 1965 and 2008 taken from the journal PDF.
From 2009 the entries are also typed into the library catalogue of the State Archives of Belgium. This site holds a partial export of that catalogue for 2009–2017. Later years are not here yet.
The bibliography is offered under CC BY 4.0. If you reuse it, credit the Royal Commission of History.

aboutSections.title: Work in progress
paragraphs: This is a trial version, and we offer it as it stands. The data are incomplete, part of the text comes from recognition of the printed page, and not every field has been checked. Use the site with that reservation.

aboutSections.title: Contributions
paragraphs: Amélie Weyts and Daniel van Meer contributed during their internship in the Master Digital Text Analysis at the University of Antwerp (2025–2026). Dr Jens Lemmens, also of the University of Antwerp, assisted with the code.
